title: nodes.info
description:
Get node information.

By default, the API returns all attributes and core settings for cluster nodes.

flat_settings.description: If true, returns settings in flat format.

timeout.description: Period to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.

node_id.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs or names used to limit returned information.

metric.description: Limits the information returned to the specific metrics. Supports a comma-separated list, such as http,ingest.
